\AddToHook{class/memoir/after}{%
  % mem14 supplies 14 pt body type on a 17.5 pt register.  The same 1.05
  % leading multiplier as the English source yields an 18.375 pt baseline.
  \linespread{1.05}%
  \setstocksize{11in}{8.5in}%
  \settrimmedsize{11in}{8.5in}{*}%
  \settrims{0pt}{0pt}%
  \settypeblocksize{650pt}{468pt}{*}%
  \setlrmargins{73.1475pt}{*}{*}%
  \setulmargins{72.485pt}{*}{*}%
  \setheadfoot{18pt}{29pt}%
  \checkandfixthelayout[fixed]%
}

% The source's diagrams and sideways derivation must be assembled in an LTR
% graphic box.  Persian prose and captions remain in their native RTL flow.
\makeatletter
\newcommand*{\OLReadableGraphicLTRBefore}{\begingroup\bbl@setdirs\z@}
\newcommand*{\OLReadableGraphicLTRAfter}{\endgroup}
\newcommand*{\OLReadableInstallGraphicDirectionFixes}{%
  \let\OLReadableOriginalAsset\olasset
  \RenewDocumentCommand{\olasset}{O{\olphotowidth}m}{%
    \begingroup\bbl@setdirs\z@
    \OLReadableOriginalAsset[##1]{##2}%
    \endgroup
  }%
  \AddToHook{env/tikzpicture/before}{\OLReadableGraphicLTRBefore}%
  \AddToHook{env/tikzpicture/after}{\OLReadableGraphicLTRAfter}%
  \AddToHook{env/sidewaysfigure/before}{\OLReadableGraphicLTRBefore}%
  \AddToHook{env/sidewaysfigure/after}{\OLReadableGraphicLTRAfter}%
}
\makeatother

\AddToHook{begindocument/before}{%
  % Empirical RTL rule probe: Babel reverses this register's physical motion.
  % +0.8773pt moves the 466.252bp rule from x=73.748bp to x=72.874bp,
  % centering it at x=306.000bp on the 612bp Letter page.
  \addtolength{\oddsidemargin}{0.8773pt}%
  \addtolength{\evensidemargin}{0.8773pt}%
  \OLReadableInstallGraphicDirectionFixes

  % Scope by stable semantic namespace, never by mutable chapter numbers.
  \AddToHook{env/proof/begin}{%
    \edef\OLStandaloneSection{\theolpart:\theolchapter:\theolsection}%
    \ifdefstring{\OLStandaloneSection}{fol:syn:ass}{\fontsize{12pt}{15pt}\selectfont}{}%
    \ifdefstring{\OLStandaloneSection}{fol:com:ide}{\fontsize{13pt}{16pt}\selectfont}{}%
    \ifdefstring{\OLStandaloneSection}{lam:cr:pb}{\fontsize{13.5pt}{17pt}\selectfont}{}%
  }%
  \AddToHook{env/defn/begin}{%
    \edef\OLStandaloneSection{\theolpart:\theolchapter:\theolsection}%
    \ifdefstring{\OLStandaloneSection}{pt:nat:rp}{\fontsize{13.5pt}{17pt}\selectfont}{}%
  }%
  \hypersetup{%
    pdfsubject={\OLCompletePDFSubject},%
    pdfkeywords={\OLCompletePDFKeywords},%
    pdfstartview=FitH,%
    pdfpagelayout=OneColumn,%
    pdfpagemode=UseOutlines%
  }%
}

\AtBeginDocument{%
  \typeout{OL-R2-TEXTWIDTH=\the\textwidth}%
  \typeout{OL-R2-TEXTHEIGHT=\the\textheight}%
  \typeout{OL-R2-FONTSIZE=\csname f@size\endcsname pt}%
  \typeout{OL-R2-BASELINESKIP=\the\baselineskip}%
  \typeout{OL-R2-ODDSIDEMARGIN=\the\oddsidemargin}%
  \typeout{OL-R2-EVENSIDEMARGIN=\the\evensidemargin}%
  \typeout{OL-R2-UPPERMARGIN=\the\uppermargin}%
}

% Keep Polish names in the Latin font even inside Persian prose. The pinned
% Scheherazade release intentionally has no L-with-stroke glyphs.
\DeclareRobustCommand{\OLPolishUpperL}{\foreignlanguage{english}{Ł}}
\DeclareRobustCommand{\OLPolishLowerL}{\foreignlanguage{english}{ł}}
\renewcommand*{\L}{\OLPolishUpperL}
\renewcommand*{\l}{\OLPolishLowerL}

% Avoid the legacy control-slot glyph used by TeX's short bar accent.
\renewcommand*{\bar}[1]{\overline{#1}}

% Preserve complemented bold theory names visually and in text extraction.
\ExplSyntaxOn
\cs_new:Npn \ol_build_theory_bar:n #1
  { \mathord{\text{\foreignlanguage{english}{\bfseries #1\char"0305}}} }
\RenewDocumentCommand \Th { m }
  {
    \tl_if_head_eq_meaning:nNTF {#1} \bar
      { \exp_args:No \ol_build_theory_bar:n { \tl_tail:n {#1} } }
      { \mathbf{#1} }
  }
\ExplSyntaxOff

% Every file in this frozen locale tree is an accepted Persian target. The
% upstream optional per-file locale marker is not consistently populated, so
% do not end an accepted localized file when that legacy marker is absent.
\let\OLUnLocalizedHook\relax
\RenewDocumentCommand{\olpartid}{o m}{\renewcommand*{\theolpart}{#2}}

% Keep the counter expansion purely numeric.  cleveref stores these tokens in
% its sorting metadata and cannot parse a bidi wrapper as a counter value.
\newcommand*{\OLFaChapterCounter}[1]{%
  \number\value{chapter}.\number\value{#1}}
\renewcommand*{\thesection}{\OLFaChapterCounter{section}}
\renewcommand*{\thethm}{\OLFaChapterCounter{thm}}
\renewcommand*{\theex}{\OLFaChapterCounter{thm}}
\renewcommand*{\thelem}{\OLFaChapterCounter{thm}}
\renewcommand*{\theprop}{\OLFaChapterCounter{thm}}
\renewcommand*{\thecor}{\OLFaChapterCounter{thm}}
\renewcommand*{\thedefn}{\OLFaChapterCounter{thm}}
\renewcommand*{\theprob}{\OLFaChapterCounter{prob}}
\renewcommand*{\thefigure}{\OLFaChapterCounter{figure}}
